doc.title: Dave Rivello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012

chapter: Listening, jazz history and the future
title: Writing for strings
summary: Recent string project for John Nugent and yearly writing for Jim Doser's high school studio orchestra.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I do. I just did a big project last summer for John Nugent, strings from the RPO and harp and jazz rhythm section, all in jazz standards. So John played that during the jazz festival and it was my first conducting with the baton experience in Eastman Theater and two thousand people. It’s supposed to start running on PBS one of these days. They filmed it to be broadcast. So that, and anytime I get the chance to write for studio orchestra — like I had mentioned Jim Doser, and every year he puts together a studio orchestra, and it’s an amazing high school studio orchestra. So every year I get to write for the strings and a studio orchestra for him. So whenever I get the chance to write for strings it’s one of my favorite things to do.
